messages:
sophia (platform): FYI — noticed a spike in fncall schema rejections for async toolhooks coming from eu-west. small % but correlated with higher tail latencies.
kevin (prodeng): ugh. is this parse errors or shape mismatch? can we get samples? :eyes: 
maría (observability): we have rejects tagged as "hard" and "timeout-truncated" in the logs. sample ids: 7219876701, 7219876723, 7219876799. attaching a raw snippet below.
maría (observability): ```
{
  "tool_name": "invoice-extractor",
  "response": "[PARTIAL] {\"invoices\": [ {\"id\": "inv_123", amount: 100 } ] }"
}
```
alex (eng): looks like downstream returned a text-wrapped partial JSON and our validator treats that as invalid object. we used strict schema for fncall for the rollout.
sophia (platform): right — the strict gate was enabled platform-wide last week for better telemetry, but async toolhooks with delayed bodies are getting flagged. we should avoid breaking customer flows.
kevin (prodeng): options: 1) debounce gate for async hooks (wait extra 200-500ms before validating), 2) soft-validate by default and promote to hard after X% users, 3) coerce common wrappers (detect leading "[PARTIAL]").
maría (observability): telemetry ask: add metric `fncall.async_reject_rate{route,cluster,validation_mode}` and a histogram for downstream latency at rejection time. also surface sample request_id in dashboard rows.
sophia (platform): agree on metrics. also need console UX: a toggle to show "soft vs hard" rejects and quick inspect raw response. current dashboard only shows counts which makes debugging painful.
alex (eng): quick PoC: we can add a post-parse sanitizer that strips leading non-json tokens if response size < 32kb and looks like JSON after. fallback to soft-reject if sanitizer touched it. patch in under an hour.
kevin (prodeng): patch sounds good but let's avoid automatic coercion for private deployments unless customer opts in. policy: sandbox sanitizer for hosted only.
sophia (platform): rollout plan suggestion: enable sanitizer + soft-validate for 10% traffic in eu-west, monitor `fncall.async_reject_rate` and `fncall.sanitizer_hits`. if no regression after 24h, go to 50% then 100%.
maría (observability): will add dashboard: panel for `async_reject_rate` by route and a table with sample request_id and validator_reason. linking draft: https://console.redwood.internal/d/async-validate (placeholder). I'll also add an alert: rate > 0.5% for 15m -> pager to oncall.
kevin (prodeng): billing question: do we bill token usage for soft-rejects? current contract says yes for consumed tokens but we might want to not bill for clear parse failures. cc finance?
sophia (platform): finance flagged before — we should not change billing mid-quarter. operationally we can suppress alerts and mark these as non-billable in analytics for now, but keep billing intact until policy change. file a follow-up with pricing if needed.
alex (eng): I'll open a PR for sanitizer + feature flag `fncall.async_sanitizer` scoped by cluster + rollout percent. PR will include unit tests for edgecases (wrapped text, trailing garbage, truncated arrays).
sophia (platform): add also a sampling hook so we persist raw_response for 1% of sanitized events for debugging.
maría (observability): done — adding `sanitizer_sample=True` label in trace. will backfill metrics from logs for the last 48h to baseline.
deploy-bot: Canary toggle `fncall.async_sanitizer` set -> 10% eu-west by sophia. :white_check_mark:
kevin (prodeng): follow-ups: (1) console UX ticket for inspect/raw view (2) billing note to finance (3) PR link + brief for release notes. who wants what?
sophia (platform): I'll take console UX ticket & release note blurb.
alex (eng): I will do the PR and tests. aim to land in next 3 hours.
maría (observability): I'll wire the dashboard panels and alerts, then post screenshots here.
kevin (prodeng): I'll ping finance and thread back. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
